verdict.rationale: Replit's docs say you can invite teammates to a project and build together, with each person starting their own Agent threads on the same project (replit-docs-14). A shared workspace model exists where admins set up services once for builders across that workspace's apps (replit-docs-40), and admin controls are available (replit-docs-5). Missing for 10: detail on real-time co-editing, roles and permissions for collaborators, conflict handling when teammates work concurrently, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of team collaboration.
